Package io.github.janglada.orkit.routing

Record Class Route

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.Route
Record Components:
vehicle - id of the vehicle serving this route
depotId - id of the depot this vehicle departs from (and returns to, unless the vehicle was assigned distinct start/end depots, in which case this is the start depot)
stops - ids of the stops visited, in travel order (depots excluded)
visits - one Visit per entry of stops, in the same order, with arrival/departure times and the running load
distanceMeters - total distance of this route, in meters
load - total declared demand picked up on this route in the default "load" dimension (pair deliveries excluded)
loads - the same total per capacity dimension with any demand
fixedCost - the vehicle's fixed cost, charged because the route is non-empty
variableCost - distanceMeters * costPerMeter + duration minutes * costPerMinute
latenessPenalty - cost of the minutes this route serves stops after their soft deadlines
breaks - the vehicle's driver breaks, in declaration order
startTime - departure time from the start depot; null without a time dimension
endTime - arrival time at the end depot; null without a time dimension
public record Route(String vehicle, String depotId, List<String> stops, List<Visit> visits, long distanceMeters, long load, Map<String,Long> loads, long fixedCost, long variableCost, long latenessPenalty, List<DriverBreak> breaks, LocalTime startTime, LocalTime endTime) extends Record
The route assigned to a single vehicle in the solved plan.

  • Method Details

    • hasTimes

      public boolean hasTimes()
      Whether times are reported on this route. The time dimension is modeled only when some time feature is present: a stop window, soft deadline or service time, a vehicle availability window, route-duration cap, break or per-minute cost, or a travel-time matrix.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
